zh-CN.clip.settings.appearance.title: 面板主题

zh-CN.clip.settings.link.title: 抓取链接预览（标题、图标）

zh-CN.clip.settings.ai.usage.title: 本月用量

zh-CN.clip.settings.clear.title: 清空剪贴板历史
zh-CN.clip.settings.clear.desc: 删除所有未收藏的历史记录，收藏夹里的内容会保留。
zh-CN.clip.settings.clear.confirmDesc: 此操作无法撤销。收藏夹里的内容会保留，其余历史记录将被永久删除。
zh-CN.clip.settings.clear.done: 已清空 {count} 条历史记录。
zh-CN.clip.settings.sync.intro: 剪贴板内容在本机加密后存到你自己的 Cloudflare R2，在多台 Mac 之间同步。点击剪贴板面板右上角的同步按钮手动同步。
zh-CN.clip.settings.sync.keyDesc: 已经在另一台 Mac 上设置过同步？在那台 Mac 上复制同步密钥，粘贴到这里。
zh-CN.clip.settings.sync.agentDesc: 复制提示词发给 Claude Code 等 Agent，它会帮你建好存储桶，并引导你拿到同步密钥。
zh-CN.clip.settings.sync.manualDesc: 在 Cloudflare 创建 R2 API 令牌，权限选「管理员读和写」，把令牌值和账户 ID 粘贴到下面。
zh-CN.clip.settings.sync.accountIdPlaceholder: 账户 ID 或 S3 地址
zh-CN.clip.settings.sync.lastOk: {time} · 收到 {received} 条，上传 {uploaded} 条
zh-CN.clip.settings.sync.rangeDesc: 收藏夹里的内容始终同步。文件和文件夹、时间和使用次数、图片识别文字不同步。
zh-CN.clip.settings.sync.rangeHint: 开启同步之前的历史记录上传多少；之后新复制的内容都会同步。
zh-CN.clip.settings.sync.maxImageDesc: 超过上限的图片不上传。
zh-CN.clip.settings.sync.shareKeyDesc: 在另一台 Mac 的 popMind 里粘贴这串密钥即可加入同步。它能解密你的剪贴板，不要发给别人。
zh-CN.clip.settings.sync.keyCopied: 已复制（不会进入剪贴板历史）
zh-CN.clip.settings.sync.disconnectDesc: 只断开这台 Mac，云端数据和其他设备不受影响。
zh-CN.clip.settings.sync.disconnectConfirmDesc: 这台 Mac 将不再同步。再次连接时粘贴同一串同步密钥即可，已同步的内容不会重复上传。

en.clip.settings.appearance.title: Panel theme
en.clip.settings.appearance.desc: Only affects the clipboard panel, not other popMind windows.
en.clip.settings.capture.title: Record clipboard
en.clip.settings.capture.desc: When off, new copies are not saved. Existing history is kept.
en.clip.settings.retention.title: Keep history for
en.clip.settings.retention.desc: Older history is removed automatically. Collection items are never removed.
en.clip.settings.storage.max.title: Storage limit
en.clip.settings.storage.max.desc: Oldest unpinned items are removed first when the limit is exceeded. 0 means unlimited.
en.clip.settings.storage.item.title: Maximum item size
en.clip.settings.storage.item.desc: Items larger than this are not recorded.
en.clip.settings.enter.title: When pressing Return
en.clip.settings.enter.desc: Direct paste needs the Accessibility permission. Without it, popMind only copies.
en.clip.settings.plain.title: Always paste as plain text
en.clip.settings.plain.desc: Strips fonts, colors and other formatting. When on, holding ⇧ keeps the formatting; when off, it is the opposite.
en.clip.settings.link.title: Fetch link previews (title, icon)
en.clip.settings.link.desc: Copied links are fetched over the network to get the page title and icon for cards.
en.clip.settings.ignoredApps.desc: Content copied from these apps is not recorded. Keychain Access and common password managers are included by default.
en.clip.settings.ignoredApps.invalid: Invalid bundle ID, for example com.example.app.
en.clip.settings.confidential.title: Ignore confidential content
en.clip.settings.confidential.desc: Skip content that apps such as password managers mark as concealed.
en.clip.settings.transient.title: Ignore transient content
en.clip.settings.transient.desc: Skip clipboard content that apps mark as transient or auto-generated.
en.clip.settings.secrets.title: Skip copies with secrets
en.clip.settings.secrets.desc: When on, copies containing API keys, private keys or login tokens are not saved. When off, they are saved and marked orange in the list.
en.clip.settings.regex.desc: Text that matches any of these regular expressions is not recorded.
en.clip.settings.ocr.title: Recognize text in images
en.clip.settings.ocr.desc: Reads text inside images so you can search for it. Runs on this Mac and nothing is uploaded.
en.clip.settings.ai.desc: Candidates are filtered locally first, then AI understands what you mean and re-ranks them. Basic search always works.
en.clip.settings.ai.usage.title: Usage this month
en.clip.settings.ai.usage.desc: Estimated at $42 per 1 billion input tokens. Output is free.
en.clip.settings.ai.privacy: Privacy: when you search with AI, truncated text snippets of the candidate items are sent to TypeSafe. Images are never sent, and sensitive items and items from ignored apps are never sent.
en.clip.settings.clear.title: Clear clipboard history
en.clip.settings.clear.desc: Deletes all history that is not in a collection. Collection items are kept.
en.clip.settings.clear.confirmDesc: This cannot be undone. Collection items are kept; all other history is permanently deleted.
en.clip.settings.clear.failed: Could not clear history. Please try again.
en.clip.settings.sync.intro: Clipboard items are encrypted on this Mac and stored in your own Cloudflare R2, so several Macs can share them. Sync by hand with the sync button at the top right of the clipboard panel.
en.clip.settings.sync.keyDesc: Already set up on another Mac? Copy the sync key there and paste it here.
en.clip.settings.sync.agentDesc: Copy the prompt to Claude Code or another agent. It creates the bucket and guides you to a sync key.
en.clip.settings.sync.manualDesc: Create an R2 API token in Cloudflare with "Admin Read & Write", then paste the token value and account ID below.
en.clip.settings.sync.rangeDesc: Collection items always sync. Files and folders, times and usage counts, and OCR text do not.
en.clip.settings.sync.rangeHint: How much history from before sync was turned on gets uploaded; everything copied afterwards syncs.
en.clip.settings.sync.shareKeyDesc: Paste this key into popMind on another Mac to join. It can decrypt your clipboard, so keep it private.
en.clip.settings.sync.disconnectDesc: Only this Mac stops syncing; cloud data and other Macs are not affected.
en.clip.settings.sync.disconnectConfirmDesc: This Mac will stop syncing. Paste the same sync key to reconnect; already synced items are not uploaded again.
